speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for presenting. You mentioned shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and a large ovarian mass. To better understand your condition, have you been experiencing any pain in your abdomen or pelvis, or any changes in your bowel or bladder habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 40-year-old nulliparous woman. The patient reports experiencing shortness of breath and noticeable increase in abdominal size over the past month. She denies any significant medical history, previous surgeries, or use of medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Carcinoma causing malignant ascites and pleural effexion (paraneoplastic syndrome). The clinical presentation of a large ovarian mass, rapid increase in abdominal girth, and shortness of breath is highly suggestive of advanced ovarian cancer with fluid accumulation. Immediate referral for staging and surgical consultation is warranted.
